code: PlinkSeed #> function (filepath)  #> { #>     filepath <- sub("\\.bed$", "", filepath) #>     if (!file.exists(paste0(filepath, ".bed"))) { #>         stop("BED file not found: ", filepath, ".bed") #>     } #>     if (!file.exists(paste0(filepath, ".fam"))) { #>         stop("FAM file not found: ", filepath, ".fam") #>     } #>     if (!file.exists(paste0(filepath, ".bim"))) { #>         stop("BIM file not found: ", filepath, ".bim") #>     } #>     fam <- read.table(paste0(filepath, ".fam"), header = FALSE,  #>         col.names = c("FID", "IID", "PID", "MID", "Sex", "Phenotype"),  #>         colClasses = "character") #>     bim <- read.table(paste0(filepath, ".bim"), header = FALSE,  #>         col.names = c("CHR", "ID", "cM", "POS", "A1", "A2"),  #>         colClasses = "character") #>     n_samples <- nrow(fam) #>     n_variants <- nrow(bim) #>     sample_ids <- paste(fam$FID, fam$IID, sep = "_") #>     variant_ids <- bim$ID #>     new("PlinkSeed", filepath = filepath, dim = c(n_variants,  #>         n_samples), dimnames = list(variant_ids, sample_ids),  #>         fam = fam, bim = bim) #> } #> <bytecode: 0x7a574b6238> #> <environment: namespace:PlinkMatrix>
